comment: Real internet VoIP/DID provider (e.g. Telnyx, Twilio Elastic SIP Trunking, VoIP.ms) with inbound call answering + topic routing enabled. Requires port-forwarding your SIP/RTP ports and setting externalIp to your public IP/hostname.

inbound.greeting: Hi! Thanks for calling. What would you like to know about?
inbound.noMatchMessage: I'm sorry, I don't have information on that topic yet.

topics.name: Example Topic
topics.description: Replace this with a description of a question topic your callers might ask about
topics.knowledge: Replace this with the factual information the agent should use to answer questions on this topic.
